# Agent Context Readiness Check

Assess whether your Revenue System provides enough context for an agent to execute a specific use case.

## What it measures

- Identity
- Relationship
- State
- History
- Intent
- Rules
- Permissions

The result classifies context as **Ready**, **Constrained** or **Unsafe** and highlights the weakest dimensions.

The tool runs entirely in the browser; answers are not sent to RevOpsHubs.

[Use the Agent Context Readiness Check →](/tools/agent-context-readiness/)
